description: Election Commission - M. A. R. Dharmasiri was Elected as the Member of the Kandy Municipal Council, M. A. K. Rakuman Selected as the Member of the Kalmunai Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government councils (Kandy Municipal Council and Kalmunai Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of elected members to fill seats vacated due to resignation and non-attendance of meetings. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters at the local government level, including candidate nominations and declarations of elected members.
